newsitem.title: USA: Sykes Enterprises files for 2.6 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Sykes Enterprises files for 2.6 mln shares.

text.p: Sykes Enterprises Inc filed on Monday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.6 million common shares.
Of the total, 1,553,320 shares will be sold by the company and 1,046,680 shares by shareholders.

It said net proceeds will be used to open additional information technology call centers and for additonal capital expenditures, working capital and general corporate purposes, including possible acquisitions.
It will not receive any proceeds from the sale by shareholders, it added.
The offering will be made through a group of underwriters led by Raymond James & Associates Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 390,000 additional shares.
